name: Temporary Resident Student Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a letter of acceptance from the Mexican educational institution, stating the student's name, degree/area of study, course, dates, and fees.
requirements.fix_path: Secure enrollment/acceptance from a Mexican institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires bank statements showing an average monthly balance over USD 8,433 (3 months), OR proof of monthly income from employment, pension, or scholarship of at least USD 843 (3 months).

evidence_required.document: Letter of acceptance from the institution

outcome.duration_length: more than 180 days, matching program length; must apply to INM for a temporary resident card within 30 days of entry

sources.title: Consulate of Mexico, Phoenix (SRE) -- Student Temporary Resident Visa requirements

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Mexico's initial build. work_rights set to 'none': the fetched source did not address employment permission for student visa holders, and Mexico's own naturalisation-by-residence rules explicitly state student temporary residence 'does not generate residency rights' toward naturalisation either (per the separately-sourced privileged-naturalisation trámite page) -- treated conservatively as a non-work, and for naturalisation purposes non-qualifying, status rather than assumed otherwise. leads_to_pr left false accordingly: student residence time does not appear to count toward the standard residence-to-PR pathways based on sources reviewed.
